integrity_statement: The full finite graph, all simplicial faces, and 132 elementary simplicial collapses are checked by a complete standalone verifier; the integral homotopy argument is given in the proof. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary four-cut complex of the twelve-vertex cuboctahedral graph and its Alexander dual are classified.
No equivariant representation, shellability conclusion, family generalization or external independent verification is claimed.
An equivalent result in unindexed or inaccessible literature cannot be excluded.
title: The ordinary four-cut complex of the cuboctahedral graph is a wedge of sixty-three seven-spheres
